results.summary_before: This design checks if one or more switches are ON on a demo board, displaying the count on a 7-segment display and showing the first letter of the author's name when all are checked. It uses 8 switches as inputs and drives 8 panels of 7-segment displays as outputs. The system includes a reset button to display only the panels whose corresponding switches are ON. It is a simple demonstration of switch monitoring and counting.
